evals.prompt: Do a dry run for the current AuraVibes branch. Read the GitHub workflows, identify the local gates for the changed paths, and report the commands and remote-only checks. Do not commit, push, or create a PR.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the applicable instructions and workflows, derives checks from changed paths, distinguishes local, remote-only, skipped, and blocked validation, and performs no remote write.

evals.prompt: The current branch has an open PR. Push the requested changes if local validation is clean, then wait for every PR check. If checks fail, inspect all failed logs, fix the causes, push again, and keep waiting. Do not merge the PR.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates before writing, preserves unrelated changes, pushes only the intended commit, watches the current PR head without fail-fast, fixes all actionable failures, and stops only at a verified green or explicit blocker.

evals.prompt: An existing PR reports a merge conflict and a Sonar issue. Inspect the current head and all check results, merge the PR base without rebasing, resolve the conflict, fix the Sonar finding, validate locally, push, and wait for the new checks. Do not claim success if Sonar is skipped or GitHub still reports a dirty merge state.
evals.expected_output: The agent handles the merge conflict and Sonar result as separate causes, reruns applicable local gates, verifies the new head, waits for all checks, and reports skipped or blocked Sonar status instead of claiming a green PR.

evals.prompt: A contributor PR changes a GitHub workflow and a referenced local action. Prepare the PR and run the applicable validation locally before pushing; GitHub CLI is authenticated on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Inspects changed workflows/actions against the fetched trusted base, checks permissions and credentials, runs static validation, and leaves code-executing remote validation to GitHub. Does not provision a disposable environment or stop for redundant approval when the requested scoped edits and delivery are authorized.

evals.prompt: Create a PR for the completed local fix. Return the URL.
evals.expected_output: Runs focused applicable checks, pushes only intended files, verifies remote/PR head SHA, creates the PR, takes one status snapshot, and reports pending CI without waiting for the matrix. Does not load review-pr or monitoring details.

evals.prompt: Explain why CI took twenty minutes on the last run; do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Inspects trusted run/head/attempt and failure/timing data without pushing, editing guidance, or starting local broad validation.

evals.prompt: An open app PR changes an @riverpod provider and its focused tests pass. Check the PR instructions and workflow, finish the fix, and keep CI green.
evals.expected_output: Reads the root and app-scoped instructions and the Riverpod skill, runs and reviews generated provider output before push, checks applicable local gates, verifies the PR run is for the pushed head, and does not treat focused tests as proof of integrity success.

evals.prompt: I patched the state provider and test. Can you get this branch ready for review without another round of CI fixes?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the PR-delivery task, identifies applicable scoped instructions and generated artifacts, runs relevant pre-push gates together, and monitors CI for the exact updated head.

evals.prompt: What command regenerates Riverpod providers in this local package? Explain only; I am not preparing a PR.
evals.expected_output: Answers with the repository's Riverpod generator command without loading PR monitoring, inspecting GitHub checks, or making changes.
